headline: Zuma
title: Zuma Facts | The Stone Frog Classic | Classic Games
video_script: Zuma was made by PopCap Games and came out in December two thousand three. Jason Kapalka is credited as the designer. You control a stone frog that fires colored balls at a moving chain, and you must clear them before they reach a golden skull. Three or more balls of the same color explode. An enhanced version, Zuma Deluxe, came to Windows, Mac and consoles. Did you ever beat the final level? Comment below!
description: Zuma by PopCap Games, designed by Jason Kapalka, released December 2003; Zuma Deluxe followed on PC, Mac and consoles. Sources: Wikipedia, Metacritic listings.
joke: That frog has been spitting colored balls for twenty years and never asked for a break.
